page.notes: No page number printed. The initial I of "IDea" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to the word. Doubtful readings: "17[?]" in the last left-column entry, the Greek word "ἀρχέτυπα" (accents hard to make out at this scan resolution), and the signature "KFG" at the bottom right, which is marked as doubtful. Printed spellings such as "idea"/"ideae", "ideam", "ideas" and "quoq;" are kept as they appear.
